title: neonauclea lanceolata subsp. gracilis
intro: Neonauclea lanceolata subsp. gracilis, commonly known as a medicinal plant native to the tropical regions of Southeast Asia, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the Rubiaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory infections, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Neonauclea lanceolata subsp. gracilis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which have been identified as responsible for its medicinal properties.
